item.title: MONTHLY AWARDS | Phil Parkinson and Sam Smith nominated for January
item.description: Wrexham AFC are pleased to announce manager Phil Parkinson and striker Sam Smith have both been nominated for the EFL’s monthly awards for January. Parkinson is nominated for Sky Bet Championship Manager of the Month after guiding the Red Dragons up to sixth in the league table with four wins and a draw in six games. item.title: TICKET NEWS | Tickets available for the Under-18s FA Youth Cup tie against Aston Villa
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s continue their FA Youth Cup run later this month as they travel to take on reigning holders Aston Villa, with tickets now available. The young Red Dragons entered the competition at the Third Round and beat Port Vale 5-1 at the STōK Cae Ras, to set up an away tie against Southend United. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 1-0 Ipswich Town (FA Cup)
item.description: Wrexham AFC booked their place in the Fifth Round of the FA Cup, as Josh Windass’ 34th minute strike earned the Red Dragons a 1-0 victory over Ipswich Town. Goalkeeper Alex Palmer was called into action early-on, but chances were few and far between before Windass broke the deadlock 11 minutes prior to the interval.
